name: Pose Keypoint Maps 2026
methodology: Every point of 9 pose-estimation keypoint schemes (BlazePose 33, ML Kit 33, COCO 17, Halpe26, COCO-WholeBody 133, OpenPose BODY_25, OpenPose COCO 18, Apple Vision 2D, Apple Vision 3D), read on 2026-10-17 from each model's own source: Python and C++ source files, configs and READMEs on raw.githubusercontent.com (branch and SHA-256 of the bytes recorded per row), Google's ML Kit reference, and the JSON Apple serves for its Vision documentation. Index and name are copied exactly as the source spells them; Apple's joint names have no numeric index and carry a null one. usedBy lists only models a fetched source ties to the scheme. One column is DERIVED: crosswalkKey, the name lowercased with every character outside a-z0-9 removed; sharedWith lists the other schemes with a point of the same key. Points are joined on that key and nothing else, so names that differ (MOUTH_LEFT and LEFT_MOUTH, RShoulder and right_shoulder) are not joined.
generatedFrom: src/data/poseKeypoints.ts (generated by scripts/fetch-pose-keypoints.mjs, then by scripts/build-datasets.mjs)

fields.scheme: The scheme's slug on this site
fields.index: The integer index the source assigns; null for Apple Vision's named joint constants
fields.name: The point's name exactly as the source spells it
fields.altNames: Other spellings of the same index in the cross-checked sources, where they differ
fields.description: The source's own description of the point, verbatim (ML Kit, Apple); null elsewhere
fields.group: Apple's documentation topic group; null elsewhere
fields.crosswalkKey: DERIVED: name lowercased, characters outside a-z0-9 removed
fields.sharedWith: Other schemes with a point of the same crosswalkKey; null when none (unmapped)
fields.usedBy: Models a fetched source ties to the scheme
fields.source: The file or page the names and indices were copied from
fields.sourceBranch: The GitHub branch read; null for documentation pages
fields.sourceSha256: SHA-256 of the source bytes as served
fields.page: This site's row for the point
